login.intro: Follow these simple steps to log in:
login.step1: Email: Enter the email address you used when registering (e.g. your Gmail address).
login.step2: Password: Type the password you chose when creating your account.
login.step3: Eye icon: Click the eye icon next to the password field to see what you have typed.
login.step4: Forgotten password: If you don't remember your password, click "Password forgotten?" to receive a link for a new password by email.
login.step5: Sign in with Google: The easiest way! Click the Google button below to log in with your Google account.

register.intro: Follow these simple steps to create an account:
register.step1: Email: Enter a personal email address that you use and have access to (e.g. your Gmail address).
register.step2: Password: Create a password with at least 8 characters that contains at least one letter (A-Z) and at least one number (0-9).
register.step3: Repeat password: Type the same password again to confirm you haven't made a mistake.
register.step4: Eye icon: Click the eye icon next to each password field to check what you have typed.
register.step5: Sign up with Google: The easiest option! Click the Google button to register with one click.

help.encouragement: Don't worry, take your time. We are here to help! Write to us at pensa.club@gmail.com
